title: New Falcons DE Za'Darius Smith reveals he retired last season to spend time with his mother before her death

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: New Falcons DE Za'Darius Smith reveals he retired last season to spend time with his mother before her death
sources.description: Za'Darius Smith retired after just five games with the Eagles last season after learning his mother was sick and didn't have long to live.
